metadata.description: Six Star Wealth (Fosun Wealth) research and trading skills for Hong Kong and US markets.

plugins.name: biopharma-data-hub
plugins.description: Public pipeline, approval, patent, and literature pulls for one biopharma name, plus upstream tracking. Objective only. No orders.

plugins.name: biopharma-strategy
plugins.description: A four-step biopharma note, or upstream tracking that keeps only material events. Objective only. No orders.

plugins.name: fw-deep-research
plugins.description: One interactive HTML research report for a named Hong Kong or US stock: business, valuation, financials, and catalysts. Objective only. No orders.

plugins.name: fw-trade-skill
plugins.description: Hong Kong and US equity orders on paper or live, after an explicit confirmation. One gateway. No research reports.

plugins.name: hk-ipo-analysis
plugins.description: Hong Kong IPO list or one HTML subscription report: five-factor score and allotment tiers. Gate, then MCP, then one file. Objective only. No orders.

plugins.name: tech-hardware-research
plugins.description: One HTML research note for a tech-hardware name or vertical: supply chain, metrics, and traps. Objective only. No orders.
